title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Approval Terms and Approval Validity
content:
**Approval rule.** A Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing plan is offered only to an applicant whose credit score at application meets the plan's minimum, and the financed amount must fall between the plan's minimum and maximum. The financed amount may not exceed the contract price less the contract's required booking deposit. An approval is recorded with its approval date and the plan; the customer may decline it at any time before funding.

**Validity rule.** An approval can be funded only within the approval validity period counted from the approval date. Calendar days are counted from the day after the approval date, and funding on the last day of the period is still within it. An approval that reaches the end of the period unfunded is cancelled, and the customer reapplies if the work is still ahead; a cancelled approval carries no charge.

## Per-plan figures the rule reads

For each of the six plans the rule reads that plan's lowest accepted credit score, its smallest and largest financed amounts and its approval validity period in calendar days; the most that may be financed on one contract is, on every plan, the contract price less the contract's required booking deposit.

## The validity window, condition by condition

| Element | Basis |
|---|---|
| Event the clock starts from | The approval date recorded on the financing account |
| Unit | Calendar days |
| Counting | Day 1 is the day after the approval date |
| Comparison | Funding must fall not later than the last day of the period |
| Last day itself | Within the period |
| Unfunded at the end of the period | The approval is cancelled, with no charge; the customer reapplies if the work is still ahead |

The approval date is taken from the company's financing record for that account, not from the customer's recollection.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

With a hypothetical approval date of 2026-03-01 and a validity period of 180 calendar days, day 1 is 2026-03-02 and the last day is 2026-08-28:

- funding on 2026-08-28 is within the period;
- on 2026-08-29 the period has ended, and an approval still unfunded is cancelled without charge.

## Points of judgement

- Declining: the customer may decline an approval at any time before funding.
- Amount: an amount below the plan's minimum, above its maximum, or above the contract price less the contract's required booking deposit cannot be financed on that plan.
- Score: the score compared is the score at application.
